problem_text:
A logistics firm must dispatch a courier to four distinct distribution hubs:
Hub P: Positioned at grid coordinates (120,143)
Hub Q: Positioned at grid coordinates (25,90)
Hub R: Positioned at grid coordinates (111,80)
Hub S: Positioned at grid coordinates (156,163)

Transportation distances between hubs are quantified in kilometers:
P to R: 63.6 km
P to S: 41.2 km
Q to R: 86.6 km
Q to S: 150.0 km
R to S: 94.4 km

Direct freight linkage between Hub P and Hub Q is unavailable.
Furthermore, the delivery circuit must incorporate exactly one of the following two critical connections: the route between Hub Q and Hub R, or the route between Hub R and Hub S.

The objective is to determine the minimal total travel distance for a closed circuit, wherein each hub is visited precisely once before returning to the origin hub.
